newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Receivers to start Fokker liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Receivers to start Fokker liquidation.

text.p: The receivers of bankrupt Dutch planemaker Fokker said Tuesday they would begin liquidation of the company with sales of non-fixed assets this fall.
Fokker has been bankrupt for more than a year and the last jet rolled off its production lines in April.

Last month, a consortium of Chinese and Russian investors said they would launch a last-ditch rescue bid, but receivers said it would take a miracle to save Fokker after a string of unsuccessful takeover talks.
